analyzed_vuln.description: `PackChunkyBytes` performs `memmove(swap1 + 1, swap1, nChan-1)` when `Extra == 0 && SwapFirst` without validating that `nChan >= 1`. If the fuzzed output format encodes zero color channels (`T_CHANNELS(info->OutputFormat)==0`), `nChan-1` underflows (unsigned) to a huge value / -1 at interceptor boundary, causing ASan `negative-size-param` in `memmove`. Crash is observed via `PrecalculatedXFORM` -> `p->ToOutput` call path.
analyzed_vuln.conditions: In `cms_universal_transform_fuzzer`, attacker controls `dstFormat` (and thus transform packing flags/channels). A transform must be successfully created from fuzzed profile + formats, then `cmsDoTransform(..., 1)` invokes `PrecalculatedXFORM`, which calls `PackChunkyBytes` as the output formatter. Trigger requires output format with `SwapFirst` set and `Extra==0`, plus `nChan==0` so `nChan-1` becomes invalid length for `memmove`.
